title: 赫卡里姆·花园小灯
description: 青绿色幽灵半人马赫卡里姆保持厚重甲胄与四足形态，安静观赏低矮花园灯，长戟陈列一侧。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Hecarim is an armored spectral centaur with a dark metal upper torso, equine body, four strong hooves, a horned helmet, and flowing teal spirit accents. Preserve the recognizable half-human half-horse silhouette but make the face a friendly simplified visor, avoiding skeletal horror. His long polearm rests securely in a tall stand, and his integrated armor fully covers the humanoid torso.
art_direction.scene: He stands calmly beside a low garden lantern, lowering his helmet slightly to inspect a small moth circling the warm light. All four hooves remain grounded and clearly separated. A simple curved hedge and one stone path suggest a peaceful evening garden, with the polearm motionless at the edge and no charge or frightening mist.
art_direction.palette: soft teal glow, charcoal violet, lantern gold, cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
